stages.title: Baseline
stages.description: Two minutes of ordinary words on your old keyboard, so every later stage is measured against your usual speed.

stages.title: Home row
stages.description: The home row sits in straight columns rather than staggered rows. Keep your fingers resting here.

stages.title: One column per finger
stages.description: Each finger moves straight up and down its own column, from the number row to the bottom row.

stages.title: Thumb clusters
stages.description: Backspace, Delete, Enter, Space and the modifiers move under your thumbs.

stages.title: The awkward keys
stages.description: Split arrows, brackets on the bottom row, = on the far left, and the ` and \ keys.
